answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the kernel of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the juniper re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the lotus of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
